title: TD mod
description: TD is a mod without a fixed foundation, ranging from fantasy to other fictional concepts
body:
# PT🇧🇷

TD é um mod que não se mantem em ter apenas uma base, sua criação varia de ideias livres e criativas como magias, invocações de servos, mobs, biomas, estruturas, dimensões e itens.

* Abaixo estão exemplo de varinha de invocaçãoes que utilizamos em nosso mod, gastam mana e invocação criaturas especiais.
![cajados](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/79dbed5149b594f96f5395b7b8637f9246c45171.webp)

* Aqui estão Rimur e Minimelos invocações das varinhas.
Rimur são frasco e não possuem nada de especial mas eles pulam para atacar.
Minimelos são fracos mas possuem a habilidade de explodir e causar efeitos.
![nossas invocações](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fd9ce6bbe01aa878903fb1c3135543a13083755a.webp)
- Marrom: causa dano normal
- Vermelho: causa envenenamento
- Carmesim: causa decomposição
- Distorcido: Causa lentidão
- Nether: Causa fogo

* Temos crafting's para plantações e alimentos magicos.
![semente](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f34f81c494256ac71f0f6855c2db3cc9f12f4390.webp)
![massa azul](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/daf97a83cad6c026a29ff21a410d8d960e4b460d.webp)

* Abaixo temos uma criatura chamada de cão, ele é uma criatura semelhante a um lobo sendo agressivo mas podendo ser domesticado você também pode faze-lo equipar uma sela para que possas montar!
![cão](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2137ef467a66620ac78d1fe66533a1932300a638.webp)
![cão](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ad4dc48a583cc154d3ab110a763db2c4f4943470.webp)

* Cão é uma raça com diversas variações, cada cão possui suas diferenças entre status e até efeitos.
![cães](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/aec4e68414962f6b6151398a5eb634fd146c809c.webp)
- Cão Selvagem
Domesticado com mel
Spawna em Taigas
- Cão Nevado
Domesticado com peixes
Spawna em area geladas
- Cão Noturno
Domesticado com Coelho
Spawna a noite
- Cão Infernal
Domesticado com itens do nether
Spawna no Nether

# EN🇺🇸

TD is a mod that doesn’t stick to a single foundation. Its creation is based on free and creative ideas such as magic, servant summoning, mobs, biomes, structures, dimensions, and items.

* Below are examples of summoning wands used in our mod.  
They consume mana and summon special creatures.
![cajados](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/79dbed5149b594f96f5395b7b8637f9246c45171.webp)

* Here are Rimur and Minimelos, summons from the wands.
Rimur are fragile and don’t have anything special, but they jump to attack.
Minimelos are also fragile, but they have the ability to explode and apply effects.
![nossas invocações](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fd9ce6bbe01aa878903fb1c3135543a13083755a.webp)
- Brown: Deals normal damage
- Red: Applies poison
- Crimson: Applies decay
- Warped: Applies slowness
- Nether: Sets targets on fire

* We have crafting recipes for magical crops and foods.
![semente](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f34f81c494256ac71f0f6855c2db3cc9f12f4390.webp)
![massa azul](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/daf97a83cad6c026a29ff21a410d8d960e4b460d.webp)

* Below we have a creature called the Cão. It is similar to a wolf — aggressive, but it can be tamed. You can also equip it with a saddle to ride it!
![cão](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2137ef467a66620ac78d1fe66533a1932300a638.webp)
![cão](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ad4dc48a583cc154d3ab110a763db2c4f4943470.webp)

* The Cão is a race with several variations. Each type has different stats and even unique effects.
![cães](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/aec4e68414962f6b6151398a5eb634fd146c809c.webp)
- Wild Cão
Tamed with honey
Spawns in Taigas
- Snow Cão
Tamed with fish
Spawns in cold biomes
- Night Cão
Tamed with rabbit
Spawns at night
- Infernal Cão
Tamed with Nether items
Spawns in the Nether
